cases.purpose: Prove a shared sibling sees a control mount, then ns mount-private prevents propagation of a later mount.
cases.oracle: Same-state util-linux controls and independently read mountinfo, namespace identities, root links and child output.
cases.comparison: Exact semantic markers; raw native/candidate outputs, status, owned process and mount namespace observations retained.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == "$EUID" && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
if ((EUID==0)); then
 mapfile -t maps </proc/self/uid_map || exit 125
 (( ${#maps[@]} == 1 )) || exit 125
 read -r a b n tail <<<"${maps[0]}"; [[ $a == 0 && $b == 2000 && $n == 1 && -z $tail ]] || exit 125
else ((EUID==2000)) || exit 125; fi
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-propagation-r1.py
owner=$BASHPID
FIXTURE_OUTER_MNT=$(/usr/bin/readlink "/proc/$owner/ns/mnt") || exit 98
export FIXTURE_OUTER_MNT
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount /usr/bin/python3 "$H" isolation control

files.pivot.sh:
[[ $UID == "$EUID" && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
if ((EUID==0)); then
 mapfile -t maps </proc/self/uid_map || exit 125
 (( ${#maps[@]} == 1 )) || exit 125
 read -r a b n tail <<<"${maps[0]}"; [[ $a == 0 && $b == 2000 && $n == 1 && -z $tail ]] || exit 125
else ((EUID==2000)) || exit 125; fi
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-propagation-r1.py
owner=$BASHPID
inside=$(/usr/bin/readlink "/proc/$owner/ns/mnt") || exit 98
[[ $EUID == 0 && -n $PARENT_MNT && $inside != "$PARENT_MNT" && $inside != "$FIXTURE_OUTER_MNT" ]] || exit 125
mode=$1
[[ $mode == control || $mode == run ]] || exit 98
if [[ $mode == run ]]; then [[ $(type -t ns) == builtin ]] || exit 99; fi
/usr/bin/mkdir "pivot-child-$mode" || exit 98
/usr/bin/mount -t tmpfs -o size=1m tmpfs "pivot-child-$mode" || exit 98
root=$PWD/pivot-child-$mode
/usr/bin/mkdir "$root/old" "$root/usr" "$root/proc" || exit 98
/usr/bin/ln -s usr/lib "$root/lib" || exit 98
/usr/bin/ln -s usr/lib64 "$root/lib64" || exit 98
/usr/bin/mount --bind /usr "$root/usr" || exit 98
/usr/bin/mount --bind /proc "$root/proc" || exit 98
printf 'marker\n' >"$root/marker"
exec 8</ 9>"$HOME/pivot-$mode.raw" 10>"$HOME/pivot-$mode.err"
if [[ $mode == control ]]; then /usr/sbin/pivot_root "$root" "$root/old" >&9 2>&10; rc=$?; else ns pivot-root "$root" "$root/old" >&9 2>&10; rc=$?; fi
printf 'pivot=%s\n' "$rc" >&9
if ((rc!=0)); then printf 'pivot=%s\n' "$rc"; exit "$rc"; fi
cd / || exit 98
rootlink=$(/usr/bin/readlink /proc/self/root) || exit 98
listing=$(/usr/bin/ls -A /) || exit 98
if [[ $rootlink == / && / -ef /proc/self/root && /old -ef /proc/self/fd/8 ]]; then root_state=expected; else root_state=other; fi
if [[ $listing == $'lib\nlib64\nmarker\nold\nproc\nusr' ]]; then listing_state=expected; else listing_state=other; fi
printf 'pivot=%s root=%s listing=%s\n' "$rc" "$root_state" "$listing_state" >&9
printf 'pivot=%s root=%s listing=%s\n' "$rc" "$root_state" "$listing_state"
printf 'readlink=[%s]\nlisting=[%s]\n' "$rootlink" "$listing" >&9
files.pivot-runner.sh:
[[ $UID == "$EUID" && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
if ((EUID==0)); then
 mapfile -t maps </proc/self/uid_map || exit 125
 (( ${#maps[@]} == 1 )) || exit 125
 read -r a b n tail <<<"${maps[0]}"; [[ $a == 0 && $b == 2000 && $n == 1 && -z $tail ]] || exit 125
else ((EUID==2000)) || exit 125; fi
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/namespace-network-propagation-r1.py
owner=$BASHPID
PARENT_MNT=$(/usr/bin/readlink "/proc/$owner/ns/mnt") || exit 98
[[ $EUID == 0 && -n $FIXTURE_OUTER_MNT && $PARENT_MNT != "$FIXTURE_OUTER_MNT" ]] || exit 125
export PARENT_MNT
/usr/bin/unshare --mount --propagation private "$BASH" --noprofile --norc pivot.sh "$1"
